push notification.note: Keep 'Push' English; consistent with mobile settings strings.

share extension.note: No existing German rendering in the app; keep the platform term (community rules allow common English terms). If a translation is required, 'Teilen-Erweiterung' is the closest iOS convention.

bottom sheet.note: UI pattern name, rarely user-facing; keep English (standard in German Android/iOS developer and UI texts).

swipe.note: Formal register: 'Wischen Sie nach links'. Existing mobile strings use informal 'Wische…'; community rules mandate Sie.

long-press.note: Formal: 'Drücken Sie lange auf eine Nachricht'.

tap.note: 'Tap X' = 'Tippen Sie auf X'; 'tap to edit' = 'zum Bearbeiten antippen'.

toast.note: No established rendering in the app; 'Toast' is developer jargon — use 'Hinweis' or 'kurze Einblendung' in user-facing text.

clipboard.note: 'Copied to clipboard' = 'in die Zwischenablage kopiert' (consistent existing rendering).

biometrics.note: Existing strings use adjectival forms: 'biometrische Authentifizierung', 'biometrische Daten'. Prefer those constructions over the bare noun.

passcode.note: Kept English in existing strings (matches iOS German UI); masculine: der Passcode.

jailbroken.note: Existing rendering: 'Geräte mit Jailbreak' (avoids the awkward participle 'gejailbreakt'). 'rooted' can be added as 'oder Root-Zugriff' when both are meant.

tablet.note: Neuter: das Tablet. One existing mobile string has the incorrect 'Tablett' (a serving tray) — do not copy that spelling.

deep link.note: No existing rendering in the app; 'Deeplink' (one word, masculine) is the established German tech term.

server connection.note: UI actions render freely: 'Add a server' = 'Server hinzufügen', 'Switch server' = 'Server wechseln'.
